title: decree plugin frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a plugin, .decree/plugins/<name>.md: one machine and the files of its scripts folder, shared as one file. The markdown body below the frontmatter tells a person what the plugin is for; decree keeps it as written. decree installs a plugin into .decree/machines/<name>.yml and .decree/scripts/<name>/ before `process`, `daemon`, `check` and `graph` read machines, and never overwrites an installed copy that was edited in place. `decree check` checks the rest: that every `needs` is in plugins/ (P2), that no plugin changed over an edited copy (P3), and the installed machine itself (V1-V21). Reference: docs/reference/plugins.md.

name.description: The plugin and machine name: equal to the file's stem, plugins/<name>.md, and the name of the installed machines/<name>.yml and scripts/<name>/ (P1).

needs.description: The other plugins this one relies on: each machine it invokes (`machine`), routes through (`router`, or the machine `router` a `model` state with no `router` uses) or emits to. Each must be in plugins/ (P2); `decree plugin import` refuses a plugin whose needs are missing.

machine.description: The machine, as .decree/machines/<name>.yml holds it, without `name`: the plugin's `name` names it. Installed with `name` first; machine.schema.json describes the rest.

scripts.description: Every file of .decree/scripts/<name>/, by its path there, to its text. A path is plain and relative: no `..`, `.`, empty parts or leading `/` (P1). An installed file is executable when its text starts with `#!`, and otherwise not. A file in scripts/<name>/ the plugin does not ship is removed when it is installed.
